name: check-car-compatibility
description: Check if a specific car make and model is compatible with Sunnypilot. Returns required hardware (device, harness, radar), best settings, and multiple configuration presets from the community.

tools.name: check_car
tools.description: Check car compatibility with Sunnypilot. Provide make and/or model to get compatibility status and recommended settings.

make.description: Car manufacturer (e.g. Toyota, Honda, Hyundai, Kia, Subaru, GM, Volkswagen)

model.description: Car model (e.g. Camry, Civic, Ioniq 5, Sonata, Outback)
